description: Fresh home on Linux: writes the logrotate conf and the systemd user service and timer under ~/.config (XDG_CONFIG_HOME is not consulted), reloads, enables the timer, healthy.

files.{{HOME}}/.config/instrukt-ai/logrotate.c:
{{STATE}}/instrukt-ai/*/*.log {
    size 50M
    rotate 30
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
files.{{HOME}}/.config/systemd/user/instrukt-a:
[Unit]
Description=InstruktAI log rotation timer

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/30
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
